checklist.title: If You Were Scammed : Do This Now
checklist.step1: Stay calm. You are not alone and help is available.
checklist.step2: Do NOT send any more money or share any more information.
checklist.step4: Tell a trusted family member or friend.
checklist.step1Body: Keep ready: your bank name, the amount, the time of the transaction, and the 12-digit UTR number from your SMS or UPI app.
checklist.step2Title: 2. Ask your bank to freeze your account and cards
checklist.step2Body: Call the number on the back of your card. Ask them to block your card and UPI. The bank does this, not this app.
checklist.step3Title: 3. Switch on Airplane Mode if you clicked a link or installed an app
checklist.step3Body: This can stop a remote-control app from working.
checklist.step4Title: 4. Take screenshots of the SMS, the chat, the link, and the payment receipt
checklist.step5Title: 5. File a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in and save the acknowledgement number
checklist.step5Body: Use the official portal to track progress and assist police investigation.
checklist.allDone: You have done the important steps.
checklist.confirmReset: Reset checklist? This clears all checkmarks.

tutorial.card1Body: No bank, government, or company will ever ask for your OTP, PIN, or password. If someone asks, it is a scam.
tutorial.card2Body: If you get a suspicious message or call, use the Check a Message feature. We will tell you if it is safe.
tutorial.card3Body: Practice spotting scams in a safe environment. The more you practice, the more confident you will feel.
tutorial.card4Body: If you think you have been scammed, tap the red bar at the bottom. It will guide you step by step.

verify.step1Title: 1. Do not click, reply, or call the number in the message
verify.step1Body: Scammers create urgency to rush you. Take a breath and stop. Never use phone numbers or links sent in an unexpected message.
verify.step2Title: 2. Open your bank app or type the address yourself
verify.step2Body: Always use the trusted official mobile banking app or type the verified website address directly into your browser.
verify.step3Title: 3. Call the number printed on your card
verify.step3Body: Turn your debit or credit card around. The toll-free number printed on the back connects you to real bank representatives.
verify.step4Title: 4. If you already shared an OTP or PIN, call 1930 now
verify.step4Body: Quick action within the golden hour stops cybercriminals from withdrawing money from intermediary accounts.
verify.step5Body: Or use the report/spam option in WhatsApp or your SMS app to protect other citizens from this scam.
